title: Remulla travelling to France to block Zaldy Co asylum bid
summary: Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla said Tuesday he will convince French authorities to reject former Ako Bicol party-list Rep. Zaldy Co’s asylum bid when he travels to France within the next 10 days.
